description: EXAMPLE curriculum for `train --curriculum <file>` (card 20261115_081635): 4 ordered stages over ONE SloughGPTTrainer — only the data swaps between stages, model/optimizer/global_step/EWC state carry across boundaries. Corpora are this repo's own docs so the example runs from a fresh checkout; point datasets[].path at your own text (an explicit file path, or a data/<name>/input.txt dataset name; .jsonl files contribute each record's text field). GATE THRESHOLDS (max_eval_loss 3.5, min_quality 2.5, max_toxicity 0.2) are no longer placeholders — calibrated on a real 4-stage run 2026-11-19 (measured: eval_loss 2.95-3.04, quality 3.06-3.83, toxicity 0.00-0.10 at the quick-train shape; margins +15% / floor-18% / 2x). REPLAY (0.15/0.2/0.25), EPOCHS (1) AND DATASET RATIOS REMAIN PLACEHOLDERS — recipe defaults chosen by hand, not calibrated; tune them to your corpus. On gate failure the default policy logs a warning, marks the checkpoint PROVISIONAL, and advances; set a stage's on_gate_fail to abort to stop the run instead. eval_text is held out from every stage.
